author: Inside Edition
description: Monster waves have been causing lots of headaches along the California coast. In retrospect, high tide on the West Coast may not have been the best time or place for a proposal. Hopeful husband-to-be Jace Harrick popped the question to his girlfriend in the surf, and the next moment, they lost the ring in the waters off San Clemente. The couple is hoping someone will find the 4-carat ring and return it to them.
title: Couple Loses 4-Carat Ring In Surf During Beach Proposal

author: Inside Edition
description: Hayden Panettiere welcomed little Kaya with boxer Wladimir Klitschko in 2014. After Kaya’s birth, Panettiere experienced post-partum depression. In 2018, she gave Klitschko full custody. Kaya moved full-time to her father’s homeland in Ukraine where she reportedly lives today. In Inside Edition’s exclusive interview with Panettiere’s mother, Lesley Vogel, she talks about her relationship with her granddaughter.
title: EXCLUSIVE: Hayden Panettiere's Mother Speaks About Her Relationship With Her Granddaughter

author: Inside Edition
description: There is a big reaction to the news that Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond. The show biz publication “Variety” came out with a list of potential candidates including Zendaya, Margot Robbie, Lupita Nyong’o and Sydney Sweeney. Also on the list is Florence Pugh, who just revealed she texted the director of the upcoming Bond movie. Inside Edition caught up with former Bond Girl Lynn-Holly Johnson, who starred opposite Roger Moore in 1981's “For Your Eyes Only.”
title: Who Will Star Opposite Robert Pattinson As The Next ‘Bond Girl?’

author: Inside Edition
description: "Good Morning America" anchor Gio Benitez appears to be the picture of good health at age 41. He has a healthy diet, doesn't smoke, and he leads an active lifestyle. He also has no family history of high blood pressure. So how did the newsman end up with coronary artery disease? Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has the story on Benitez's shocking diagnosis, and what comes next for the popular ABC News personality.
title: 'Good Morning America's' Gio Benitez Shares Shocking Diagnosis

author: Inside Edition
description: It's safe to say this boat trip didn't go as planned. Two teenagers had to be helped when their boat capsized in Sanibel, Florida. The sheriff's office shared this video of the rescue effort by its Marine Unit. The teens were just sitting on top of the upside-down boat waiting for someone to find them. Officials say the teens weren't injured. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2 Teens Rescued After Boat Capsized Off Florida Coast

author: Inside Edition
description: A drummer was fatally shot after playing a gig and his family wants answers. KPHO spoke to relatives of Isidro Rodriguez, 37, who was killed in Phoenix, Arizona on Nov. 8th as he left a home where he’d been hired to play the drums at a party. His brothers say playing drums was one way he helped support his family. His day job was cutting hair at a barber shop in Mesa. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Family Pleads For Help In Case of Father Shot Dead After Drumming Gig: Reports

author: Inside Edition
description: Freeman Johnson, the oldest of the few remaining Pearl Harbor survivors, has died. The veteran died Saturday at his home in Centerville, Massachusetts. Johnson was one of the estimated 87,000 military personnel on Oahu on Dec. 7, 1941, and was below deck working on a boiler of the USS St. Louis when the Japanese surprise attack happened. Johnson was 106 years old.
title: Oldest Living Pearl Harbor Survivor Dies at 106

author: Inside Edition
description: Microbiologists say some hotel carpets are “germ traps” harboring potentially dangerous bacteria that could make you sick. To find out if there was germy gunk lurking in some hotel carpets, Inside Edition visited two major hotels near Times Square in New York and with the help of a wet vac took samples that were then sent to a lab for testing. The results may gross you out.
title: How Clean Are Some Hotel Carpets? Why Experts Say You Should Pack Your Slippers!

author: Inside Edition

title: Hayden Panetierre's Mother Shares How She Learned Of Daughter's Death #shorts
